title: Release Title Search Fee Schedule for Retention Remittances
content:
# Release title search fee schedule — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the release title search fee is part of the retention remittance. The closing date is read from the loan record: the HECM's under the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) product, or the Summit loan's under the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage product.

The release title search fee is USD 95.00 when the loan's closing date is at least 120 whole calendar months before the remittance date, and USD 65.00 when it is at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole calendar months before it; a loan closed more recently takes no higher fee under this schedule, and a loan with no closing date counts 0 months.

| Whole calendar months from the closing date to the remittance date | Release title search fee |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | USD 95.00 |
| 60 to 119 | USD 65.00 |
| fewer than 60, or no closing date | no higher fee under this schedule |

*Hypothetical:* a loan closed on 15 March of one year and a remittance dated 14 March ten years later counts 119 whole months (USD 65.00); dated 15 March ten years later it counts 120 (USD 95.00).
